name: Grimsby
doing: writing in his diary on a bench by the station
thought: The crumbs on the ground are arranged in a pattern I do not recognize.

feeling.words: A crumb of baklava, precise as a man who has never been wrong. The teaspoon glints in the morning light, unspoken reason. A map, crusted and stubborn, refuses to fold.

place.name: a bench by the station
place.words: on a bench by the station
